findings.evidence: app/regions/chicago.json has no sources entry for the Chicago RSS/ICS candidate; no matching source ID or endpoint was found in the Chicago release.
app/regions/norfolk.json has no LibCal source entry; the app contains a different Norfolk event/source link, not the approved LibCal candidate.
app/regions/wolf-trap-va.json contains active source nps-wolf-trap with provider nps_events and parkCode wotr; motherbird/regions/wolf-trap-va/pois.json contains event records with that provenance.

conclusion: Approval is recorded for provider research. Only Wolf Trap is active in the app. Chicago and Norfolk require provider implementation and release validation before they can be considered landed.
